content.value: In an automobile safety test conducted by the quality control department, the (15) average tire pressure in a sample of 62 tires (out of 1000 tires) was found to be 24 pounds per square inch, and the standard deviation was 2.1 pounds per square inch.
(ii) Construct 95% confidence interval for the population mean.
